_README: Share-unlock calendar. Every date here is UNCONFIRMED unless its entry says
otherwise: they were transcribed from secondary sources (news aggregators, a
tweet, a video), not from the prospectus. Confirm each against SEC EDGAR --
search the issuer, open the S-1 or 424B4, and read the 'lock-up' section --
then set "confirmed": true. The tools label unconfirmed dates as such every
time they show them, because trading the wrong date is worse than not
